content: Written 2026-10-07 16:42, self-approved (user 16:3x: one map, causal online update, no session-end pass; answer myself, do not wait). Real row 4 v7 = S3: the carried GaME map (one model, as v4) trained in each session only by that session's keyframes; earlier sessions' keyframes stay as stored views (they render the map of their time, T1) but no longer train. Flags: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes (no --g5 / --inside: memory ends only online, by the layer's element rule, closed-state background and object states). Staged: --sessions a, then --resume --sessions ab, then --resume. Evaluated per stage with eval_row.sh (official chain unchanged), compared with rows 1/3; G1 F1 decides.

A measurement is used once (recursive Bayesian estimation: the posterior after session k is the prior of session k+1; re-using session-k frames in session k+1 counts them twice). GaME's training loss, seeding, A1 additions and T1 masks are unchanged; only the sampler draws the current session's keyframes (TrackedGaME.optimize_model, train_from). Eq. 5 self-check: keyframe k of session S trains the Gaussians alive at t_k; old keyframes render their own time and are not trained against.
No new constant (GaME flat.yaml, layer constants of the online channel as committed).
eval_row.sh unchanged (median export over every stored view, timeline first echo, objects4d, D1/D2/D3, ghost, retention, retention_correct, G8 in C).
smoke_s3_real (A300+B300): no error; B online ends closed_background 5508, element_rule 811; peak 1.26 GB.
Peak ~ v4's (8.8 GB C); one heavy job (GPU.lock). Disk used inside ~360 GB.

A: no memory; ~ v4's A (G1 F1 93.08) to row 1 (93.21). B: v4 B F1 89.6 -> 90.5-92.5 (old keyframes no longer pull memory back; B-unobserved memory still costs precision under the session-only reference: V1 proxy measured -1.7 F1 for it). Refuted if B F1 <= v4's 89.6.
